_doc: Values of run TMA for application CARV (logs/TMA.events.txt, logs/TMA.RUN_INFO, logs/TMA.time.txt): simulation (simulate.sh) of a git archive of tag r11-rc3 (commit 7a17693, repo_state=archive) of carv_e (CAR-V and E on the 4x5 mesh) with the release by tick (RELEASE_MASK=1048575, release=tick) and the UCX-OS kernel without nested interrupts (isr=no_nesting) at F_CLK = 434.912 MHz, 11.5 ms of platform time, Questa 2025.3, riscv64-elf-gcc 12.2.0, 2026-10-14 (run_r11c.sh: make -C experiments/multiapp sim F_CLK=434912000 SIM_NS=11500000 BUILD=build/tma). Analysis: make -C experiments/multiapp check-tma (python -m rttools.paper.rtlapp --app CARV --composition composition.json, release rule tick from the RUN_INFO).
